hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);const f=(j.tool_response&&j.tool_response.filePath)||(j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path);if(f)console.log(f)})" | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && npx prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; }
